text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—It begins! The ultimate ordeal to test 
your intellect, physical stamina, and van 
der Waals forces!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what in the world... are you planning 
to start now, pray tell...?!

Rewinding a few hours earlier— having 
inadvertently entered Gold Ship's line of 
sight, we were promptly marched off to the 
riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You folks will be participating in an 
'interview' to determine if you're 
qualified to join my grand scheme—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
An-an interview...? Scheme...? What is 
your actual goal here in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Then allow me to recount it right here 
and now. The heart-wrenching tale of a 
lonely boy standing in the park, which 
brought all of Golshi to tears!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Seems he moved here recently, but the 
kid's so painfully shy... Even when other 
kids are playing, he can't bring himself 
to say 'can I join in?'...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Do you know how agonizing solitude is for 
a young heart...?! Even single-molecule 
wires are linked together in a chain! I 
gotta do something for him...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
C-calm down... Though, that is 
surprisingly far more wholesome than I 
expected...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
To give that boy the push he needs, I 
require comrades willing to help. Now do 
ya understand why we need this interview?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-well... framed like that, it is not as 
though I can simply refuse, but...

And so, alongside Mejiro McQueen, I ended 
up taking Gold Ship's "interview"—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*Haa... haa...!* Wh-Why... in the world do 
we have to climb a cliff...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ain't it obvious?! You know what they 
say—a lion pushes its cubs down a 
bottomless ravine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That explains absolutely nothing desu wa! 
In the first place, how is any of this an 
interview?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*Sniff*... Please! I need partners in 
crime! It's for that sweet old granny on 
an isolated island waiting for her only 
son to return...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't this about saving a boy at the 
park?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hit it out of the pa~rk, take the win~! 
Home run, un-de-feated, in~vin~cible~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oraaa, put some more chest into it! Those 
puny cheers won't reach the field!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What does! Cheering at the top of our 
lungs! Have to do with saving! That 
li~ttle bo~y desu nooooo!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ain't it obvious?! To save that nostalgic 
candy store full of precious memories, you 
gotta cheer with real fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Your story changed agaaaain desu 
waaa!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Aww yeah, nice hustle! You two passed 
with flying colors! You're hired!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*Haa... haa...* You say we're hired, but I 
don't even know what the goal is 
anymore...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I told ya it was to fire up that 
little kid! And there's only one true path 
to doing that!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Entrepreneurship! We're incorporating! 
Yakisoba Food Cart Inc., OPEN FOR 
BUSINESS!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
choice_data_list:
Like playing pretend food cart with the 
kids?
I see... so that's the angle.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you messin' with me?! I'm dead 
serious about slangin' yakisoba! And you 
call it 'playing pretend'?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Looks like your mindsets still ain't 
ready! Time for Round 2 of the interview, 
let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Again, why yakisoba desu no?! None of 
these interview tests make any sense wa!

...And so, we were dragged through even 
more bizarre trials under the guise of an 
"interview"...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's basically the Schrödinger 
equation spawned by the butterfly effect.
choice_data_list:
A revolution of extratropical cyclones, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Look at you, getting it! Let's also keep 
resource conservation in mind with 
water-cooled engines and fewer disposable 
chopsticks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me, please wait a moment!? Why 
are the two of you acting like you 
completely understand each other!?!?!?
